description: This is a test script for the lighttpd web server, specifically testing core condition handling using the LightyTest framework. It performs various HTTP request simulations and verifies responses to ensure correct condition processing.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A testing utility class for lighttpd server, providing methods to initialize, check features, handle HTTP requests, and manage server lifecycle.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature, such as PCRE support, is available in the environment.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process for testing.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Simulates handling an HTTP request and returns the response from the server.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Stops the lighttpd server process after testing is complete.
